incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate on gateway (service: inference-gateway) starting ~5864123400, error spike correlated with kv-prefix-store ops. auto-sampled traces show spike in prefix lookup latency and timeouts.

sam: seeing it, noise is loud on dashboards. 5xx and 504s. paging oncall.

maria: on it, joining. do we have traffic samples? which clusters?

sam: mostly us-west-2 clusters api-prod-*, some additional across dedicated pools. top span is `kv.prefix.read` with `io_timeout`.

aj: tagging in as second oncall for handoff readiness. any recent deploys?

sam: small config push 5864123200 touched prefetch/pinning on prefix cache + a GC snapshot job kicked around same time.

maria: hunch: snapshot GC caused inline snapshot-to-archive mismatch, causing eviction/repair churn and prefix-index lookups to fall back to slow path -> timeouts. need logs + checksums.

lee: adding logs from gateway (abridged):
```
ERR inference-gateway handler=prefix_lookup id=abc123 latency_ms=12003 err=kv_read_timeout
WARN kv-store shard=7 eviction=high open_files=1024 pending_ops=483
INFO gc snapshot start id=snap-20260601-5864123001
```

maria: can someone run checksum compare on kv-prefix index on shard 7? command: `kvcmd diff-checksum --shard 7 --prefix-index`

sam: running now...

sam: result: `mismatch: live 0x4f2a1b, archive 0x4f2a1c` on ~120k keys for shard 7.

maria: confirms corruption drift, likely repair attempts are thrashing. that aligns with eviction spike and increased short-lived connections.

aj: mitigation idea: flip prefix-cache bypass for production routes until we stabilize (route requests directly to kv-store read-through, avoid cached index path). pros: reduces prefix-index hot operations. cons: higher token latency for some requests.

lee: we can set feature-flag `prefetch.prefix_enabled=false` via runtime-config on gateway cluster. patch ready.

sam: go for it, but coordinate with deploy-bot. also throttle background repair/compaction jobs.

deploy-bot: queued change `runtime-config:prefetch.prefix_enabled=false` for api-prod-us-west-2, will apply in rolling fashion across 6 nodes. Confirm to proceed with rollout?

maria: confirm. also pause snapshot GC jobs on affected shard: `gcctl pause --shard 7` and reduce repair concurrency: `repairctl set-concurrency 1`

sam: applying pause now.

sam: patch rolled to 2/6 nodes, initial error rate dropped ~30% in those nodes.

maria: good signal. continue rollout, monitor for customer impact. map high-latency customers.

lee: observed tail latency increase for a small % but 5xx decreased overall.

aj: notifying support to throttle or notify affected enterprise customers if we expect degraded latency >30s for some calls.

sam: support pinged: ticketing numbers created for top 3 affected customers (acct-991, acct-114, acct-337).

maria: will also add temporary routing fallback to older prefix-index snapshot replica for reads: `kvroute set replica=legacy-replica-2 --shard 7` if bypass doesn't stabilize.

lee: bypass rollout completed to all nodes at 5864123580. global 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 5m window.

maria: excellent. leave bypass on while we run checksum repair offline. schedule maintenance window to rebuild shard 7 index from archive copy and verify checksums.

aj: I'll pick up oncall in 2 hours. handoff summary: root cause suspected snapshot/GC mismatch produced checksum drift -> repair churn -> prefix-index eviction storm -> elevated 5xx/timeouts. mitigation: runtime bypass of prefix-cache, pause GC, reduce repair concurrency, alert support.

sam: can we add ephemeral alert to avoid auto-retries hammering the kv-store? maybe a circuit-breaker on gateway that returns 429 to reduce pressure.

maria: good call. adding `gateway.circuit_breaker.kv_read=0.5` (50% error budget) to throttle retries and return 429 quickly.

deploy-bot: circuit-breaker config applied.

lee: after all mitigations: 5xx stabilized ~0.9% and tail 99th latency reduced from 12s -> 4s. some customers still see slow calls but no major outages.

maria: next steps: full rebuild of prefix-index for shard 7 from archive under maintenance, validate checksum, re-enable prefetch feature flag once verified, run canary. create postmortem doc and link runbook entries for inline snapshot handling.

aj: leaving oncall. transferring pager to night-oncall at 5864123700.

sam: thanks team. will add a short incident summary to incidents channel and open postmortem ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: severity=sev2, customer-impact=partial (latency degradations, some 5xx), mitigations implemented (cache-bypass, GC paused, repair concurrency reduced, circuit-breaker), next steps=rebuild shard 7 index, validate checksums, re-enable prefetch after canary.

maria: tagging for postmortem owners @eng-reliability and @eng-ml infra. I'll start the doc.

sam: handoff complete.
